How weeks are counted
×

A week runs Monday to Sunday. Complete the number of sessions you chose. Scheduled rest days do not use a session slot.

A completed week adds one. Extra sessions do not add extra streak points. A week still in progress does not end your streak.

Recovery keeps your place. A paused week protects the previous streak without adding a completed week. Resume when you are ready; your goal starts again the following week.

Your history stays yours. If a week ends below your goal, the consecutive count starts again. Your completed weeks and sessions remain.
